register.labelZh: MUCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: muck about 可以表示某人浪費時間或胡鬧;muck about with something 則表示亂動某件物品或它的控制裝置。；muck in 可以直接而自然地表示大家一起動手幫忙完成工作。；談論清理馬房、兔籠或其他動物居住的地方時,常會使用 muck out。；muck somebody around 可以表示某人受到不公平對待或被迫久等;muck something up 則表示錯誤令計劃、工作或機會被搞砸。
register.summaryEn: Muck about can describe people wasting time or behaving foolishly, while muck about with something describes interfering with an object or its controls. Muck in is a friendly and direct way to describe everyone joining together to help with a job. Muck out is commonly used when talking about cleaning places where horses, rabbits or other animals live. Muck somebody around describes someone being treated badly or kept waiting. Muck something up describes a mistake that spoils a plan, task or opportunity.
